about:
Why Ode exists

A private place
to hear yourself.

Ode began with a simple question: what if speaking about your day could help you understand it a little better?

Less effort to begin.
More room to reflect.

Start in your own words.

Journaling can be hard to return to when a blank page feels like another task. Ode gives you two ways in: record a thought or write it down.

Return with a little context.

Your entries become a journal you can revisit. Reflections use recent entries to notice emotions, themes, and names that recur. You decide what feels true.

Keep the boundaries clear.

Ode supports reflection. It does not diagnose or replace a mental health professional. Sharing with a therapist is your choice, through limited, time-bound access.

Built in conversation.

Ode is in early access, being tested with users and mental health professionals. If you would like to help shape it, we would like to hear from you.

Privacy Policy

Last updated: 27 October 2026

On this page

What Ode Actually Is

Ode is a voice journaling app. You talk, we turn it into text, reflect it back to you, and help you make sense of your inner life over time. The whole thing is built on one core belief: your thoughts belong to you. Not us. Not brands. Not data brokers. You.

This document tells you exactly what we collect, why we need it, how long we hold onto it, and what you can do about any of it.

What We Collect and Why

Launch waitlist

If you choose to join the waitlist, we store only your email address and the signup time in our Supabase database, to send an Ode launch update. Your selected website goal stays in this browser and is not added to the waitlist.

Voice recordings

When you record something, the audio goes straight to secure cloud storage without ever touching our servers. Once it has been transcribed, the audio file is deleted permanently. We genuinely don't keep it. There's no archive of your voice sitting somewhere.

Transcripts

The text version of what you said is stored on our servers. This is the heart of Ode - it's what powers your journal history, your reflections, and the emotional patterns we track over time.

AI-generated content

The reflections, mood scores, emotional tags, key quotes, nudge messages, and dream interpretations we generate - these get saved alongside your entry so your history stays intact.

Your account details

Just your email and display name. If you sign in with Google or Apple, we only see what you explicitly authorise - nothing more.

Your notification token

If you turn on morning nudges, we store a device token to deliver them. You can switch it off anytime in Settings and it's gone.

Basic usage data

Things like when you recorded, how long the session was, and which version of the app you're using. We don't track what you tap, how you scroll, or anything behavioural beyond the app itself.

What We Don't Collect

No location. No contacts. No photos. No tracking pixels. No advertising SDKs quietly hoovering up your data in the background. We don't sell your data for advertising - not now, not ever.

How We Actually Use Your Data

To write your reflection

Your latest transcript, along with your five most recent entries for context, gets sent to Anthropic's Claude API. That's what generates your personalised reflection. Anthropic doesn't use API data for training by default.

To spot if you're struggling

Every transcript is automatically checked for signs of distress - first by keyword matching, and if it's unclear, by a follow-up AI check. If something concerning is detected, crisis resources appear immediately. No human reads your entries.

To get better over time

The more you use Ode, the more it understands your recurring patterns, themes, and emotional language. This all lives in your account and never leaves it.

To send your morning nudge

If you opt into notifications, we craft a short message based on your last entry and send it at whatever time you choose via Firebase. It's entirely optional.

For Therapist Share

If you choose to share a link with your therapist, they get an anonymised view of your mood trends and AI summaries - never your actual transcripts or recordings. The link is passcode-protected and expires after 72 hours automatically.

How Long We Keep Things

Audio recordings

Deleted immediately after transcription - not recoverable.

Transcripts & analyses

Until you delete your account.

Share links

72 hours, then permanently removed.

Account data

Until you request deletion.

Launch waitlist

Until the launch notice is sent or you ask us to remove your email at talktoode.dev@gmail.com.

The Services We Work With

We use a small number of trusted external providers to run Ode. Here's who they are and what they do with your data:

Anthropic (Claude)

Generates your reflections and handles crisis detection. They don't train on API submissions.

OpenAI (Whisper)

Transcribes your audio. Audio is sent to them only for this purpose.

Cloudflare R2

Holds your audio temporarily while transcription is happening, then it's deleted.

Supabase

Manages your account login, including social sign-in.

Firebase (Google)

Delivers your push notifications if you've opted in.

Azure Speech Services

If you use Therapy Mode with AI voice, your assistant's responses are processed here.

Apple App Store / Google Play

Handle all payments as in-app purchases. We never see your card details - the stores take care of that entirely.

A Note on Mental Health Data

Journal entries and mood data are sensitive. We treat them that way:

  • No Ode employee reads your entries.
  • Crisis detection is automated - no human review.
  • Therapist Share is opt-in, anonymised, and passcode-protected.
  • We don't use your emotional data to target you with ads.
  • We don't share it with insurers, employers, or anyone else.

Children

Ode isn't for anyone under 13. If you think a child has made an account, email us at talktoode.dev@gmail.com and we'll delete it straight away.

Your Rights

You're in control. Here's what you can do at any time:

  • Export your data - Settings → Export my data. You'll get a PDF of your full journal history.
  • Delete your account - Settings → Delete account. Everything goes - entries, analyses, account data. This can't be undone.
  • Turn off notifications - Settings → Notifications, or through your phone's system settings.
  • Revoke therapist access - Share links expire on their own after 72 hours, or contact us to kill one early.

For a full copy of everything we hold about you, or for any GDPR requests, email talktoode.dev@gmail.com.

Security

All data moves over HTTPS. Passwords are hashed, never stored as plain text. Tokens expire. Audio is stored in private buckets with time-limited access only. Database access is locked down to our application servers only.

No system is completely airtight. If you find something, please let us know at talktoode.dev@gmail.com before making it public.

If This Policy Changes

If we make any significant changes, we'll let you know by email or in-app - at least 14 days before they kick in. The date at the top of this page always shows you what version you're reading.

Contact

Questions, requests, or concerns: talktoode.dev@gmail.com

What Ode is and what it isn't

Ode is a voice journaling app with AI-powered emotional reflection. It is not a therapist. It is not a doctor. It cannot diagnose you with anything, and nothing it says should be treated as medical advice or clinical guidance.

Therapy Mode is an AI-assisted conversation that draws on your journal history - it's named carefully to make clear it's not actual clinical therapy. Nothing in the app replaces a real mental health professional.

If you're in crisis, please reach out to a professional. You can find crisis resources anytime inside the app under Settings → Get help now.

Your account

Age

You need to be at least 13 to use Ode. If you're under 18, you're confirming you have a parent or guardian's permission.

Accuracy

Please give us accurate information when signing up, and keep your login details safe - that's your responsibility.

One account per person

You can't create multiple accounts to get around plan limits.

Closing accounts

We can suspend or close accounts that break these Terms - we'll try to give notice when we can. You can delete your own account anytime in Settings.

Your content is yours

Everything you record or write in Ode belongs to you. We ask only for a limited licence to process it - meaning we can transcribe it, run AI analysis on it, store it, and deliver it to your devices. That's it.

We don't claim ownership of your journal entries. We don't use your content to train AI. We don't sell it.

You are responsible for what you record. Please don't use Ode to store or send anything illegal, harassing, or that violates someone else's rights.

Subscriptions and payments

Plans

Ode has a Free plan and two paid options - Ode+ and Ode Pro. Paid plans are one-time passes: 30 days (monthly) or 365 days (annual). They don't auto-renew. You pay once, get your pass, and buy again if you want more.

Therapy sessions

Sessions can be purchased individually or are included in Pro. Your very first session is always free. The charge goes through when the session begins.

Refunds

Because access starts the moment you purchase, we can't refund unused days. If a technical issue stopped you from accessing the app, email us at talktoode.dev@gmail.com within 7 days.

Price changes

If prices change, we'll give you at least 14 days' notice by email or in-app.

App Store / Play purchases

For therapists

The Therapist Portal is for licensed mental health professionals only. By registering, you're confirming you hold the appropriate credentials in your country or region.

You can only see a client's data if they've explicitly shared it with you via a passcode-protected link. You cannot go beyond what they've shared, and you cannot store, redistribute, or use their data for anything outside direct clinical care.

You're responsible for keeping your portal login secure and for handling client data in line with the professional and legal standards that apply to you - including HIPAA where relevant.

Crisis detection

Every journal entry and therapy session message is automatically scanned for signs of distress in two stages. If something is flagged, crisis resources appear in-app right away.

This is not a replacement for emergency services. If you or someone else is in immediate danger, call emergency services - 112 in India, 911 in the US - or a crisis helpline immediately.

The system is designed to err on the side of caution: it would rather show resources when they're not needed than miss a genuine crisis.

AI-generated reflections are not clinical assessments. They can be wrong, incomplete, or miss important context. Please don't make major personal, medical, or legal decisions based solely on what Ode tells you.
